forge:storage_blocks/honeycombs.reason: Productive Bees comb blocks carry bee-specific resource data; they are not interchangeable vanilla honeycomb blocks.

forge:raw_materials/uranium.reason: Alex's Caves uranium retains biome and Tremorzilla mechanics; both raw materials feed its machines and smelt to yellorium.

forge:ores/iron.reason: Alex's Caves galena iron ore is a stone-variant iron ore (a new ore block in the Magnetic Caves), not a duplicate material or producer to merge with vanilla iron. liveOnly: the group exists through forge:ores/iron -> #minecraft:iron_ores, and Forge's own tag is not in the cached-jar scan, so only the live pack test sees it.

forge:ingots/brick.reason: Supplementaries deliberately tags its ash brick (made from ash, a distinct material) as a brick for brick-accepting recipes; it is not a second copy of the clay brick. liveOnly: Forge's own tag is not in the cached-jar scan, so only the live pack test sees the group.
